biomarkers.name: BAP1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Loss of BAP1 supports malignant mesothelial proliferation versus benign/reactive mesothelial proliferations; germline BAP1 tumor predisposition syndrome should be considered in appropriate clinical/family history contexts

biomarkers.name: MTAP / CDKN2A loss
biomarkers.prevalence: Less common than in pleural mesothelioma; CDKN2A homozygous deletion is uncommon in peritoneal mesothelioma
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports malignancy when present, but lower sensitivity in peritoneal mesothelioma than pleural

biomarkers.name: ALK rearrangements
biomarkers.prevalence: Rare; enriched in peritoneal mesothelioma, particularly in younger patients/women
biomarkers.clinical_use: May predict benefit from ALK inhibitors in ALK-rearranged peritoneal mesothelioma

biomarkers.name: NF2
biomarkers.clinical_use: One of the hallmark tumor suppressor alterations in malignant peritoneal mesothelioma

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Diffuse peritoneal serosal/peritoneal thickening or nodularity with epithelioid, biphasic, or sarcomatoid histology
variants: well-differentiated papillary mesothelial tumor (indolent, female predominant, generally no strong asbestos association)
multicystic mesothelial proliferation / benign multicystic mesothelial tumor (very indolent)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Grading is not simply extrapolated from pleural mesothelioma; epithelioid peritoneal mesothelioma may be risk-stratified by architectural/cytologic features, while biphasic and sarcomatoid histologies are high grade by definition

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Poorly characterised relative to pleural mesothelioma

cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm — lateral plate mesoderm (visceral peritoneum from splanchnopleure)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Epithelioid tumors retain mesothelial differentiation (calretinin+, WT1+); well-differentiated papillary mesothelial tumor and multicystic mesothelial proliferation are low-grade/borderline mesothelial entities with retained mature mesothelial phenotype
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Sarcomatoid/dedifferentiated progression can occur, analogous to mesothelioma at other serosal sites
